slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 乾坤大陆，旭日王朝，都城燕京城，像一条沉睡的巨龙一般，傲然屹立在这广袤的乾坤大陆上。
旭日王朝皇宫，西北角上，有座与繁华宫殿格格不入的破败院落，门口上挂着【听轩小筑】的牌匾。
主殿中，一个快十八岁的少年有气无力地躺在床榻上，旁边还有一个十五岁的小丫头，小丫头焦急地看着床上的少年。
“七殿下，您怎么了啊，要不然我还是去找御医给你看看吧，您现在这个样子真的不行了。”
“小丫头，不必了，我快撑不住了，要是我死了的话，你就把我之前写的信，交给我父皇，然后出宫去吧。”
“七殿下，您不要这么说，您一定会没事的，我现在就去找御医。”
与此同时，有两抹黑色的身影快速向殿中驶来，一掌劈开了殿门，然后又射出一股掌风，直接袭上了躺在床榻上的七皇子，七皇子直接吐出一口鲜血，昏死了过去。
小丫头直接大喊起来：“来人啊，有人刺杀七皇子了！”
两个黑衣人看着昏死过去的七皇子，直接用功法将大殿点燃，随后便极速退去。
小丫头赶紧跑到七皇子身边，一边大声喊叫，一边想把七皇子拖出殿中。
巡逻的禁军突然看着西北方有火光，也是急速地往这边赶，等人赶到火光地时，发现是听轩小筑的主殿着火了，立刻安排人员去灭火，而禁军小队长却是向东边的御书房奔去，当到达御书房时，内监大总管已经在门口等他了，随后便跟着进入了御书房中，见到了旭日王朝的主宰，旭日王朝皇帝萧鼎锋。
萧鼎锋气宇轩昂、头戴黄金龙冠、身着五爪金龙龙袍，端坐在那个所有皇子都梦想坐上去的五爪龙椅上，正在全神贯注地翻看手中的奏折，见到内监大总管刘雨领进来的禁军小队长，开口问道：“发生了何事？”
禁军小队长赶忙低下头回道：“回陛下，听轩小筑着火了，七皇子和侍女生死不明。”
话音刚落，整个房间的气压都变低了，随后萧鼎锋对刘雨说：“你去看看，发生了什么，有特殊情况，你自行处理。”
“是，陛下。”随后便和禁军小队长退出了御书房，向听轩小筑奔去，别人不知道，但是他可是非常清楚的，陛下是很喜欢七殿下的，要不然当年发生的事情，也不会只留下七殿下，他得赶紧去看看，到底发生了什么。
蓦然，七皇子猛地睁开了双眼，却发现自己身处火场中间，还有一个小姑娘在奋力地将他往外面拽，同时他的脑袋像是被万千蚂蚁啃食一样，疼痛难忍，一股股不属于他的记忆如汹涌澎湃的江水不断地涌入他的脑海中，但是时间很短几乎是一瞬，便恢复了正常，他也终于接受完了这具身体的所有记忆和信息。
我竟然穿越了！
自己竟然穿越到这里，通过继承原主的记忆，他叫萧风，是旭日王朝的七皇子，像是以前的封建王朝时代，然而10年前，他的母妃却突然失踪，从此杳无音信，皇帝一怒之下，就将原主囚禁在了听轩小筑10年，而小丫头是在他10岁的时候，原来负责他起居的嬷嬷死了，才重新给他安排的。这个陌生的世界与之前的世界不同的是，这里有着人人都向往的职业——武者。
低阶的武者就像是特种兵王一样，可以轻而易举地对付数十个普通人。
中阶的武者就如同战神附体一样，可以以一当千，同时能对付上万普通人，
顶尖的武者就如同神只一样，可以镇压一个国，甚至更加夸张。
这也使得在这个大陆上，以武为尊，涌现出了各种王朝、皇朝、宗门以及世家。呈现出了各朝争霸，宗门世家混战的混乱局面。
而在这乾坤大陆上，武道境界依次划分为：
武徒→武者→黄阶→玄阶→地阶→天阶→圣阶，武徒和武者是低阶武者，每个阶段有五个层级，黄阶、玄阶、地阶是中阶武者，每个阶段有九个层级，天阶和圣阶为顶尖武者，天阶也是有九个层级，但是圣阶只有一个，在这个大陆上都是凤毛麟角的存在，已知的圣阶只有十个人。

现在先不想这些了，眼下还是要快速地脱离火场，要不然别说成为武者了，现在马上就要交待在这了，随后他便赶紧睁开眼，对小丫头说：“你放下我，我背你出去。”小丫头被突然开口的萧风吓了一跳，赶忙说：“七殿下，您赶紧往外跑，不用管我了，禁卫军在外面救火，你一个人一定能逃出去的。”萧风看着眼前的大火，只是紧紧地抱着小丫头，因为他发现原主的身体应该是被人长期下毒了，一点力气都使不上，心想着，我这刚穿越过来，连这精彩的世界还没有见过，就要死去了吗？我不甘心啊！
突然，萧风耳中响起了一道天籁般的机械声音！
检测到宿主内心的不甘，燃起浓浓的求生欲，和争霸世界的野心，符合系统绑定条件！
【叮咚，唯我主宰系统开始和宿主绑定。】
突然一阵风吹来，刘雨已经先行飞到了听轩小筑，一掌便将萧风周围的火直接拍散，萧风也顾不得听系统的提示了，赶忙抱着小丫头，跳出火场，随后便看见了站在最前面的刘雨，于是便想向着刘雨行礼，毕竟是救了他和小丫头一命的，刘雨见萧风准备给他行礼，立马用内力托住了，说道“七殿下，您可不能给老奴行礼啊，这可是要折煞老奴了，您没事吧。”
“没事，劳烦刘公公了，只是今晚的住处还麻烦刘公公帮忙安排一下。”
“这个没问题的，您就不要操心了，让奴才来给您把下脉吧。”
随后刘雨将手伸出去扣在了萧风的脉门上，片刻之后，说“您没有大碍了，晚上麻烦您在听轩小筑的偏殿委屈一下，明天一早，再行安排，奴才还要给陛下回话，奴才先告退了。”

content_en:
Qiankun Continent, the Rising Sun Dynasty, the capital of Yanjing City, stands proudly on this vast Qiankun Continent like a sleeping dragon.
In the northwest corner of the Imperial Palace of the Rising Sun Dynasty, there is a dilapidated courtyard that is incompatible with the prosperous palace. There is a plaque of "Tingxuan Xiaozhu" hanging on the door.
In the main hall, an almost eighteen-year-old boy was lying weakly on the bed, and there was a fifteen-year-old girl next to him. The little girl looked anxiously at the boy on the bed.
"Your Highness Seventh, what's wrong with you? Otherwise, I'd better go find the imperial doctor to check on you. You really can't survive like this."
"Little girl, it's no need. I can't hold it anymore. If I die, please give the letter I wrote before to my father and then leave the palace."
"Your Majesty Seventh, please don't say that. You will be fine. I will go find the imperial doctor now."
At the same time, two black figures quickly came towards the palace, opened the door of the palace with one palm, and then shot out a wave of palm wind, which directly hit the seventh prince lying on the bed. The seventh prince spit out a mouthful of blood and passed out.
The little girl shouted directly: "Come here, someone has assassinated the seventh prince!"
The two men in black looked at the unconscious Seventh Prince and used their skills to set the hall on fire, then quickly retreated.
The little girl hurriedly ran to the seventh prince, shouting loudly and trying to drag the seventh prince out of the palace.
The patrolling Forbidden Army suddenly saw a fire in the northwest and hurried towards it. When they arrived at the place of fire, they found that the main hall of Tingxuan Xiaozhu was on fire. They immediately arranged for personnel to put out the fire. However, the Captain of the Forbidden Army rushed to the Royal Study Room in the east. When he arrived at the Royal Study Room, the Chief Internal Supervisor was already waiting for him at the door. Then he followed into the Royal Study Room and met the ruler of the Rising Sun Dynasty, Emperor Xiao Dingfeng of the Rising Sun Dynasty.
Xiao Dingfeng was an imposing figure, wearing a golden dragon crown and a five-clawed golden dragon robe. He was sitting on the five-clawed dragon chair that all princes dreamed of sitting on. He was concentrating on reading the memorial in his hand. When he saw the captain of the imperial army led in by Liu Yu, the chief internal supervisor, he asked: "What happened?"
The captain of the imperial army quickly lowered his head and replied: "Your Majesty, Tingxuan Xiaozhu is on fire, and the death of the seventh prince and the maid are unknown."
As soon as he finished speaking, the air pressure in the entire room dropped. Then Xiao Dingfeng said to Liu Yu: "Go and see what happened. If there are special circumstances, you can handle it yourself."
"Yes, Your Majesty." Then he and the captain of the Forbidden Army exited the imperial study and ran towards Tingxuan Xiaozhu. Others didn't know it, but he knew very well that His Majesty liked His Highness the Seventh Prince very much. Otherwise, what happened that year would not have left His Highness the Seventh Prince alone. He had to go and see what happened.
Suddenly, the seventh prince suddenly opened his eyes, only to find that he was in the middle of a fire scene, with a little girl struggling to pull him out. At the same time, his head felt like it was being eaten by thousands of ants. The pain was unbearable. Memories that did not belong to him poured into his mind like a surging river. However, in a short time, almost in an instant, he returned to normal, and he finally accepted all the memories and information of this body.
I actually traveled through time!
He actually traveled here and inherited the memory of the original owner. His name was Xiao Feng, and he was the seventh prince of the Rising Sun Dynasty, just like the feudal dynasty in the past. However, 10 years ago, his mother-in-law suddenly disappeared and there was no news from her. The emperor was furious and imprisoned the original owner in Tingxuan Xiaozhu for 10 years. The little girl was rearranged when he was 10 years old, and the nanny who was responsible for his daily life died. The difference between this strange world and the previous world is that here there is a profession that everyone yearns for - warrior.
Low-level warriors are like special forces kings, able to easily deal with dozens of ordinary people.
Intermediate warriors are like those possessed by the God of War. They can fight one against a thousand and deal with tens of thousands of ordinary people at the same time.
Top warriors are like gods, able to suppress a country, even more exaggeratedly.
This also led to the emergence of various dynasties, dynasties, sects and aristocratic families on this continent where martial arts was the most respected. It presents a chaotic situation of dynasties competing for hegemony and sects and aristocratic families fighting.
In this Qiankun Continent, the realm of martial arts is divided into:
Warrior → Warrior → Yellow Level → Xuan Level → Earth Level → Heaven Level → Holy Level. Warriors and warriors are low-level warriors. Each stage has five levels. Yellow level, Xuan level, and earth level are intermediate level warriors. Each stage has nine levels.
Don't think about these things now. You still need to get out of the fire scene quickly, otherwise, let alone becoming a warrior, you will be here soon. Then he quickly opened his eyes and said to the little girl: "Put me down and I will carry you out." The little girl was startled by Xiao Feng who suddenly spoke, and hurriedly said: "Your Majesty, Seventh Prince, you run out quickly, no need. Never mind me, the Imperial Guards are putting out the fire outside. You can definitely escape by yourself." Xiao Feng looked at the fire in front of him and just hugged the little girl tightly, because he found that the original owner's body must have been poisoned for a long time, and he couldn't use any strength. He thought, I have just traveled through time and have not even seen this wonderful world, am I going to die? I'm not willing to give in!
Suddenly, a heavenly mechanical sound sounded in Xiao Feng's ears!
Detecting the unwillingness of the host, igniting a strong desire for survival and ambition to dominate the world, it meets the system binding conditions!
[Ding dong, the self-dominance system has begun to bind to the host. 】
Suddenly a gust of wind blew, and Liu Yu had already flown to Tingxuan Xiaozhu. With one palm, he knocked away the fire around Xiao Feng. Xiao Feng didn't care to listen to the system prompts, and quickly jumped out of the fire scene with the little girl in his arms. Then he saw Liu Yu standing at the front. So he wanted to salute Liu Yu. After all, he saved his life and the little girl's life. When Liu Yu saw Xiao Feng preparing to salute him, he immediately used his inner strength to support him and said, "Your Majesty, Seventh Highness, you can't salute this old slave. This will hurt my life. Are you okay?"
"It's okay. I'm sorry to bother you, Eunuch Liu. I just need Eunuch Liu to help arrange the accommodation tonight."
"This is no problem. Don't worry about it. Let me check your pulse."
Then Liu Yu stretched out his hand and clasped it on Xiao Feng's pulse. After a moment, he said, "You're okay. Please stay in Tingxuan Xiaozhu's side hall for a while tonight. We'll make arrangements tomorrow morning. I have to reply to His Majesty, so I'll take my leave now."
